purpose: Independently audit footer, summary, schema, and channel coverage for every full MCAP take currently listed by the official CooperScene portal, without downloading any complete MCAP or running a perception model.

sourceAndScope.inventoryBasis: The official config.json was independently Range-read and byte-for-byte matched the supplied local copy before its 14 datasetUrl entries were resolved.
sourceAndScope.evidenceBoundary: Schema names and channel coverage come only from independently parsed MCAP summary records. Project-page descriptions and the local Foxglove layout were not treated as schema evidence.
sourceAndScope.take9NonExtrapolation: Take 9 was Range-read and parsed as one independent take under the same procedure as takes 1-8 and 10-14. No take 9 value was copied into another take.

evidencePolicy.directObservation: Content length and Range support are established by HTTP 206 Content-Range responses; MCAP structure and counts are established by decoded Header, Footer, Schema, Channel, Statistics, ChunkIndex, and SummaryOffset records.
evidencePolicy.blockedRule: A take is marked blocked if its exact head, footer, or footer-directed summary Range is rejected, truncated, internally inconsistent, or cannot be parsed independently.
evidencePolicy.metricChannelRule: An independent latency, loss, or jitter channel requires a case-insensitive metric token in the decoded channel topic or its resolved schema name.
evidencePolicy.noDocumentationSubstitution: Portal or project descriptions are inventory context only and cannot substitute for binary schema/channel evidence.

byteAccounting.hashRule: Every rangeEvidence.sha256 is over the exact response body bytes for that request, never over the complete remote MCAP.

officialRangeRequest.purpose: Range-read the official portal inventory and verify the supplied local config copy.
officialRangeRequest.retrievalMode: Pre-fetched by a direct curl --config HTTP Range batch; parsed offline.

localLayout.useBoundary: Read as requested for context only; not used as schema or channel evidence.

reproducibility.localLayoutUseBoundary: The local layout was read because it existed, fingerprinted, and excluded from schema/channel evidence.

observedDifferencesAndAnomalies.observation: Content length, duration, message count, and chunk count vary substantially by take; the exact minima and maxima are recorded above.
Take 1 has complete topic coverage but three directed throughput channels have fewer messages than the other nine; exact counts are stored in take 1 anomalies.
The sampled MCAP 206 responses omitted an Accept-Ranges response header, but exact partial responses with valid Content-Range proved Range usability for every take.

priorTake9CrossCheck.result: Matches the earlier take 9 trace audit, now without using take 9 as evidence for any other take.

anomalies.interpretationBoundary: The summary establishes count differences only; no cause is inferred without payload/chunk analysis.

limitations: This is a footer/summary/schema/channel coverage audit. It does not decode MCAP message payloads or infer throughput values.
A complete channel inventory does not prove that every expected time step has a message; take 1 demonstrates why per-channel summary counts must be retained.
No cause is assigned to missing per-link messages, chunk-count variation, or file-size variation.
No latency, packet loss, or jitter value is inferred from foxglove.Vector3 fields or from project-page statements.
No complete MCAP, preview MCAP, sensor archive, or model checkpoint was downloaded or executed.
